title: A review of mixed-integer linear formulations for framework-based energy system models
rationale: 综述能源系统框架的混合整数线性数学表述并给出统一优化模型，核心为传统运筹规划实现，未涉及AI学习或科学AI模型。
evidence_quote: the mathematical formulation for a mixed-integer optimization model comprising all the model features discussed in this work.
